assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: photographic portrait for a dark course landing page.
Input image 1: the canonical identity reference of Bia, the ibe.IA AI ambassador. Use it ONLY for her identity, not for its location or wardrobe.
Primary request: create a new polished editorial portrait of Bia, visibly smiling, approachable and confident. Her face is carried over exactly from the reference image: the same bone structure, the same hazel-green eyes, the same light freckles across her nose and cheeks, and the same warm copper-brown wavy hair. She must be unmistakably the SAME woman, not a generic lookalike.
Expression and pose: a warm natural smile with a little upper teeth showing, lively friendly eyes, relaxed forehead, direct eye contact; self-assured, upright posture and relaxed shoulders. Competent and at ease, not laughing, not timid, not stern. No hand under chin, no hand near face.
Wardrobe: elegant contemporary feminine black silk or crepe blouse with a softly open collar, small gold hoop earrings. Beautiful well kept fabric and understated styling.
Scene/backdrop: clean deep plum-black studio background #121024, gently luminous behind the head, subtly fading to near black at the edges and bottom; no room or scenery.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:10 canvas, centered waist-up portrait. Entire head and hair visible, around 8 percent headroom. Her shoulders occupy about the central 55 percent of the image, with generous clean dark space on both sides. Natural arms lowered, crop at waist. Solely artwork; all landing-page text will be real HTML outside this image.
Lighting/style: refined realistic editorial studio photography, soft flattering warm key light, gentle cool-violet rim, natural skin texture and freckles, not glossy plastic skin. Focus on Bia.
Constraints: no other people, objects, desk or props. No text, no UI, no logos. No watermark and no sparkle icon or graphic mark of any kind anywhere in the frame.
assets.refinement:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this portrait of Bia. Keep exactly the same recognizable face and identity, bone structure, hazel-green eyes, nose and cheeks freckles, copper-brown wavy hair, outfit, pose, earrings, centered framing, lighting, dark background and image dimensions.
Change ONLY her facial expression: make her distinctly MORE SMILING with a warm natural confident smile showing the upper teeth clearly. The corners of her mouth lift and her cheeks and eyes show friendly warmth. She looks approachable and delighted to welcome a student, while still calm, competent and self-assured. This must be an obvious friendly smile, not the current almost-closed slight smile, and not a laughing open mouth. Keep realistic face anatomy, natural teeth and natural skin texture. No change to any other element. No text, watermark, sparkle icon or graphic mark anywhere.
assets.note: Geração nativa com a referência de identidade, seguida de edição nativa apenas do sorriso. Bia é personagem de IA, sem biografia ou depoimento atribuído.
